title: Abazimbi b’Eminaala
intro: Mu kiseera edda ennyo, embuga ey’amaanyi yasituka, eyawulwamu olw’ebikolwa byayo eby’ekitalo eby’okuzimba n’amaanyi gaayo ag’entiisa. Ekitongole kino eky’omuggundu kyaweebwa eby’obugagga bingi n’obukodyo obw’omubiri, naye ate ne balonda ekkubo ery’okujeemera obubaka obw’obwakatonda obwasindikibwa okubalungamya. Emboozi yaabwe ekola ng’essomo ery’amaanyi mu bitabo by’ebyafaayo, obujulizi ku biva mu kugaana amazima.
clues: Twaweebwa amaanyi n’obuwanvu obw’amaanyi ennyo mu mubiri, obutafaananako bantu balala bonna ab’omu kiseera kyaffe.
Twali tumanyiddwa okuzimba ebizimbe ebinene n’empagi empanvu mu buli kifo ekiwanvu, nga tulowooza nti tujja kubeerawo emirembe gyonna.
Omubaka okuva mu ffe yasindikibwa okutulabula, ng’atuyita okusinza Allah yekka n’okusuula ebifaananyi byaffe.
Twabuuza omubaka waffe n’amalala, nga tubuuza oba bazze gye tuli okutufuula okusinza Allah n’okusuula ebyo bajjajjaffe bye basinza.
Ensi yaffe yalimu ensuku, ensulo, n’ennimiro ezigimu, naye obugagga bwaffe twabutwala ku maanyi gaffe, so si Mutonzi waffe.
Olw’obutakkiriza bwaffe obutasalako n’okusekererwa, ku nkomerero twazikirizibwa empewo ey’entiisa, ey’obusungu eyabuuka okumala emisana n’ekiro bingi.

arabic: فَأَمَّا عَادٌۭ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَقَالُوا۟ مَنْ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً ۖ أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَهُمْ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةًۭ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا يَجْحَدُونَ
verse: As for ʿAad, they were arrogant upon the earth without right and said, "Who is greater than us in strength?" Did they not consider that Allāh who created them was greater than them in strength? But they were rejecting Our signs. (41:15)
